name: Remote CoWorker
task: Someone — or an AI — to answer the calls we miss
summary: Managed virtual assistants for admin, customer support, live chat and bookkeeping, hired through a specialist and billed by the hour.
best_for: small businesses that want a dedicated remote assistant for admin, support or bookkeeping and are happy to get a quote from a specialist first
skip_if: you want software you can try without a conversation, you need a published price list, or you need only a few hours of help a month
honest_knock: There is no public rate card, so you cannot compare the price with other providers before you speak to sales. The contract length, minimum hours and cancellation terms are not stated on the site.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-09 on remotecoworker.com) The homepage says plans start at $7.99 an hour. The pricing page does not list a rate card: it holds a four-step quote form that asks how many staff you want to outsource, your company size, your sector and the roles you need, and a calculator where you pick a category, role, experience level (entry, mid or senior) and a full-time (160 hours a month) or part-time (80 hours a month) schedule. When we opened the calculator without a selection it showed zero values, so we have no role-level rates. The page says the rate is all-inclusive and lists recruitment and vetting, IT support, quality assurance, payroll and benefits, HR management and 24/7 operations. The page does not name the currency behind the dollar sign, a minimum number of hours, a contract length or a cancellation term.

compare_with.name: Wing Assistant
compare_with.why: Wing Assistant is another managed virtual assistant service in our directory. Ask both for the all-in rate of the same role and compare minimum hours and notice periods

open_questions.question: Can a customer cancel at any time, and what happens to an annual plan that is cancelled mid-term?
Which data can a customer export, in which formats, on which plans?
Where is customer data stored, and can a customer choose the region?
Is there a minimum number of seats or users on any plan?
